AI agents

I build with AI agents

I write my code with AI agents. I tell them what to build, read what they produce, test it and ship it.

  1. BriefSay what I want in plain words, with the details that matter.
  2. GenerateThe agent writes and edits the code.
  3. ReviewI read the changes and run the app.
  4. ShipFix what is wrong, then push it to GitHub.
